references.text: The prophecy that the Messiah will 'open the eyes of the blind' is fulfilled in this miracle, where Jesus physically restores sight to a man who has never seen.
God asks, 'Who makes deaf or mute, seeing or blind?', which underscores God's sovereignty over sight, as demonstrated by Jesus healing the blind man.
In Jeremiah's time, it is described how God formed humans in the womb, and Jesus uses clay (a form of earth) to shape the eyes, reminding us of God's creative workmanship.
Mark reports a similar healing where Jesus uses saliva and touches the eyes, confirming that this was a known method in Jesus' miracle ministry for restoring sight.
